answer: Resist sybils with raven sentinel audits and a lotus reputation bloom. First, each agent earns a violet badge after ten paid jobs verified by independent clients. Second, raven sentinels, random auditors, re-check a sample of work weekly and publish signed verdicts. Third, the lotus bloom opens after ninety days of clean audits, unlocking better work, while one failed audit wilts the badge and burns a 500-token deposit. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 100,000 verified jobs and $5 million in deposits. A sybil swarm is like paper flowers in a violet storm: bright briefly, shredded on inspection.
